questions.stem: How many bits are needed to give each of 64 circuits a different number?
questions.explain: 2⁶ = 64, so 6 bits are enough to number 64 circuits.

questions.stem: A packet is 1500 bytes long. How many bits is that?
questions.explain: One byte is 8 bits, so 1500 × 8 = 12000 bits.

questions.stem: A 50 Mbps link is 40% utilised. How many Mbps of traffic is that?
A link sends 6 Mbit in 3 seconds. At the same rate, how many seconds does it take to send 10 Mbit?
questions.explain: The rate is 6 / 3 = 2 Mbit per second. Then 10 / 2 = 5 seconds.
